author: Jaykingsen
quote: After all the hype and the long wait, I am extremely disappointed. To me, GTA 6 doesn't feel even remotely like its direct predecessor – a lot of it feels unfinished, superficial, and just slapped together without any care. Instead of real progress and the strengths that made the previous game so special, it feels like we were lured in with big promises and completely ripped off in the end. For the price and the name, this is simply weak.
